code:
set -euo pipefail

pg_dump -U northbridge -d orders | gzip > "$BACKUP_FILE"

if ! [ -s "$BACKUP_FILE" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: backup is empty" >&2
    exit 1
fi
caption: pipefail matters here -- without it, a failing pg_dump can hide behind a successful gzip.
A backup that only lives on the server it protects isn't a backup.
